document.name: soemdsp-sandbox tooltip master
document.purpose: Edit user-facing tooltip and interaction-help text here instead of hunting through app markup or event code.

common.editText: click to edit | drag to select text

constraints.cpu: show CPU-constrained controls | can make the processor work harder, e.g. Additive Osc Harmonics
constraints.ram: show RAM-constrained controls | can increase memory pressure, buffers, or stored data
constraints.gpu: show GPU-constrained controls | can make visual rendering or shader work heavier

workspace.pan: middle-drag to move the modular view freely | Touch: drag empty workspace to move the view | Ctrl+middle-drag or Alt+middle-drag slowly zooms, including over modules and controls | Ctrl+Shift+G aligns the view to the grid
workspace.resize: drag to resize workspace by grid units
workspace.recenterOrigin: recenter modular view at X 0, Y 0

view.midiKeyboardDevelopment: show or hide the mouse-playable keyboard panel
view.zoomIn: zoom in | click for the next integer zoom level | Shift-click adds 0.25 | Ctrl/Cmd-click adds 0.10
view.zoomOut: zoom out | click for the previous integer zoom level | Shift-click subtracts 0.25 | Ctrl/Cmd-click subtracts 0.10
view.zoomReset: current zoom: {zoom} | click to reset zoom to exact 1:1 | double-click to type a zoom level
view.zoomHelp: click - or + for integer zoom levels | Shift-click steps by 0.25 | Ctrl/Cmd-click steps by 0.10 | click the zoom number for exact 1:1, or double-click to type a level | wheel over the workspace to zoom freely | Ctrl+Shift+G aligns to the grid
view.gridHelp: click to show or hide the modular grid
view.snapGrid: click: snap modular view pan, zoom, and edges to the grid | Shift-click: toggle grid-snapped movement while middle-dragging the view
view.tipsEmbed: move the tips in-flow, beside the resource meters
view.tipsFloat: move the tips back into their own floating window

timing.globalSmoothing: global smoothing time in seconds | controls how quickly smoothed parameters glide to new values | drag to tune | double-click to type | Ctrl-click to reset to one audio block
timing.speedUnderConstruction: speed control is under construction | shown as a future global timing multiplier, not active yet
timing.pitchReferenceHz: Pitch Reference Frequency in Hz | frequency sounded at the Pitch Reference Note under this patch's 0.1V/Oct convention | drag to tune | double-click to type | Ctrl-click to reset to default (100Hz)

parameterSettings.tooltip: tooltip text stored in this parameter's metadata spec | language-neutral, authored by C++, JavaScript, or any future module source
parameterSettings.kind: parameter value type and default formatting behavior
parameterSettings.unit: unit text shown next to the parameter value
parameterSettings.maxDigits: maximum number of displayed digits for this parameter value | minimum 1 (0 is invalid)
parameterSettings.max: highest value this parameter can reach
parameterSettings.mid: middle reference value for mid skew | slider center lands on this domain value | also bipolar fill center when bipolar is on
parameterSettings.min: lowest value this parameter can reach
parameterSettings.default: value used when the parameter is reset
parameterSettings.step: smallest normal increment | use 0 or any for continuous values
parameterSettings.choices: comma-separated choice labels for stepped parameters
parameterSettings.skew: slider response curve | off = linear | mid skew bends around MID | custom skew = mid-style power curve driven by SENSITIVITY | edge skew = S-curve driven by SENSITIVITY (fine near ends or center)
parameterSettings.skewSensitivity: used by custom skew and edge skew | range −1…+1 | custom: 0 = linear, +1 = finer near min, −1 = finer near max | edge: 0 = mild, +1 = more travel near ends, −1 = more travel near center | hidden when SKEW is off or mid skew
parameterSettings.linearSmoothing: legacy: use Smoothing Type L instead of unchecking this
parameterSettings.bipolar: center the amount fill on MID (usually 0) so negative and positive values grow outward from the middle
parameterSettings.smoothingSeconds: how long this parameter's glide takes, in seconds | 0 snaps instantly | only used when smoothing source is Internal or Internal + Global
parameterSettings.smoothingModeGlobal: 🌍 Global: ignore this parameter's own smoothing time, use the app-wide global time
parameterSettings.smoothingModeBlockSize: 📟 Block Size: smooth for one audio block, ignoring this parameter's time and the global time
parameterSettings.smoothingModeInternal: 🙂 Internal: use only this parameter's own smoothing time | 0 is instant
parameterSettings.smoothingModeInternalGlobal: 🙂🌍 Internal + Global: add this parameter's own time to the global time
parameterSettings.smoothingModeOff: ❌ Off: always instant, ignoring this parameter's time and the global time
parameterSettings.smoothingTypeLinear: L Linear: no filter — value snaps instantly (replaces the old Linear smoothing checkbox)
parameterSettings.smoothingTypeTwoPole: 2P Two-pole: two cascaded one-poles — steeper than 1P, lighter than Papoulis
parameterSettings.smoothingTypePapoulis: Π Papoulis: 3rd-order Optimum-L lowpass (monotonic, steeper than one-pole)
parameterSettings.showSign: always show a plus or minus sign for this parameter
parameterSettings.wraparound: let the parameter wrap from max to min and min to max
parameterSettings.displayChoices: show choice labels instead of only numbers
parameterSettings.divideChoices: draw visible separators between choice regions

script.apply: validate and apply the current patch script
script.download: save this patch into the local sandbox saved-patches folder
script.updateDefault: validate current patch script and save it as the init patch
script.save: save this patch into the local sandbox saved-patches folder

settings.uiDevOpen: click to open or close the floating UI development helper
settings.uiSettingsOpen: click to open or close user UI settings
settings.uiDevMove: drag to move the UIDEV helper
settings.uiSettingsMove: drag to move the UI settings panel
settings.makePlugin: export the current circuit as a multiplatform audio plugin | currently unavailable
settings.makeModule: design a reusable DSP module from the current circuit or selected nodes | currently unavailable
settings.makeWidget: build a custom UI widget/performer control for circuit interactions and visual performance | currently unavailable
settings.sharePatchCommunity: share this patch with the community so others can load, remix, and learn from it | currently unavailable

module.drag: drag to move modules | click to select | Ctrl/Shift+click adds or removes from selection | Ctrl/Shift+drag adds to selection while moving
module.move: drag to move modules | click to select | Ctrl/Shift+click adds or removes from selection
module.titleMove: drag to move modules | click to select | Ctrl/Shift+click adds or removes from selection | Alt+click an empty I/O section to toggle bypass | when module buttons are hidden, Alt+click the title also toggles bypass
module.displaySettings: click opens this module's display settings | Alt+click shows or hides the display
module.metaparameters: click to open this module's metaparameters | Alt+click shows or hides this module's sliders
module.textBoxEdit: display-only text | edit content from this module's actions menu | text clips to box height, scales down to fit width | mouse wheel zooms the modular view
module.bypass: click to bypass this module | bypassed modules are removed from the compiled engine
module.include: click to include this module in the compiled engine
module.outputOn: click or press Space to turn live OUTPUT on
module.outputOff: click or press Space to turn live OUTPUT off
module.outputToggle: click or press Space to toggle live OUTPUT
module.executionActive: compiled order: {order} | runs at this step in the current execution plan
module.executionBypassed: compiled order: bypassed | ignored by the compiled engine
module.executionInactive: compiled order: inactive | not reachable from Output or a visual sink
module.executionListItem: compiled order {order}: {nodeName} | selection only happens from move handles or marquee

displaySettings.globalLineThickness: global display line thickness for scope traces
displaySettings.globalSkipSamples: skip tiny discontinuities in global scope traces | higher values hide more abrupt sample jumps
displaySettings.dot1Toggle: turn the global display dot on or off
displaySettings.dot1Size: global display dot size in pixels
displaySettings.dot1Preview: preview image for the global display dot
displaySettings.backgroundColor: face plate / background color (2D Trace, PhosphorLight, Number Readout)
displaySettings.localCycles: number of waveform cycles shown in the selected module display
displaySettings.localSync: sync the selected module display to the incoming waveform period
displaySettings.localFrequencyReset: reset oscillator display tracing on frequency cycles
displaySettings.localScroll: scroll the selected output display instead of period-locking it
displaySettings.blinkShape: shape used by this module's blink-light display

traceDisplaySettings.save: save these Trace Display drawing settings to this module
traceDisplaySettings.restore: restore the last saved Trace Display drawing settings
traceDisplaySettings.defaults: reset the Trace Display drawing settings to factory defaults
traceDisplaySettings.closeSave: save changes and close Trace Display settings
traceDisplaySettings.closeDiscard: discard changes and close Trace Display settings
traceDisplaySettings.zoomSeconds: 1D Trace history window in seconds | 0 is a short snap | up to 10 s for slow signals (LFO, envelopes)
traceDisplaySettings.fftSize: Regular STFT window length 128…16384 | larger = finer frequency, longer time smearing | hop = N/Overlap
traceDisplaySettings.smooth: PAMGuard 3×3 Gaussian on STFT hop columns (1 2 1 / 2 4 2 / 1 2 1) | softens grain | opt-in
traceDisplaySettings.historySeconds: Spectrogram time span 0–5 s | full face width ≈ this many seconds of audio when the ring is full | hop from Overlap
traceDisplaySettings.sweepSeconds: 1D Phosphor free-run sweep | seconds for one full left→right pass | e.g. 2 = two seconds to cross | match your signal period for a stable heart-monitor beam
traceDisplaySettings.sweepHz: legacy 1D Phosphor sweep rate (crossings per second) | migrated to Sweep (s) = 1/Hz on load
traceDisplaySettings.burn: display trail amount | 0 clears the trail | 1 keeps the longest trail
traceDisplaySettings.decay: display trail fade speed | 0 fades slowly | 1 fades quickly
traceDisplaySettings.pixelDensity: Face buffer density | Trace: vector stroke into a coarser/finer canvas (0 chunky lo-fi · 1 full face · 4 AA) | 1D/2D Phosphor: energy grid scale
traceDisplaySettings.background: Face plate color under phosphor/trace (default pure black #000000) | no CSS screen blend — black stays black
traceDisplaySettings.dotBudget: Max soft stamps per frame | under budget uses only enough for smooth lines | over budget spreads dots evenly with skips so the whole signal stays visible
traceDisplaySettings.skipSamples: samples skipped after a vertical discontinuity | use 0, 1, or 2
traceDisplaySettings.padding: Trace Display vertical padding per side | 0 uses the full display height
traceDisplaySettings.bipolarBrightness: Phosphor Dot brightness mode | Off: only 0..1 lights up | On: -1 and +1 are equally bright
traceDisplaySettings.dot1Size: soft-stamp diameter as a 0..1 fraction of the face min side | 0 is tiny | 1 fills the face
traceDisplaySettings.lineThickness: edge softness 0–1 | 0 hard stroke (best default) | 1 mild soft edge inside the line (trace does not expand footprint; phosphor still bleeds outward)
traceDisplaySettings.brightness: dot or 1D Trace brightness | values above 1 are allowed
traceDisplaySettings.color: dot or 1D Trace color | drag hue/bright/sat on the color widget to scan without opening a native picker
traceDisplaySettings.secondarySize: secondary signal size as a 0..1 fraction of the display square (Output's Right channel)
traceDisplaySettings.secondaryLineThickness: Right-channel blur 0–1 | same hard→soft meaning as primary Blur (Output)
traceDisplaySettings.secondaryBrightness: secondary signal brightness | values above 1 are allowed (Output's Right channel)
traceDisplaySettings.secondaryColor: Output Right channel color | drag hue/bright/sat on the color widget to scan | combine meet is derived from Left+Right
traceDisplaySettings.stereoBlend: Output stereo blend | Meet: L-only·C_L + R-only·C_R + meet·C_meet (meet from Left/Right; red+blue→green) | other modes are standard canvas composites (Add/Screen/Over/…)
traceDisplaySettings.capEnabled: show or hide the 0D Value line end caps
traceDisplaySettings.lineLength: 0D Value line length | 1 reaches the display edge | lower values pull both ends inward
traceDisplaySettings.capSize: 0D Value cap thickness as a 0..1 fraction of the display square
traceDisplaySettings.capLength: 0D Value cap length as a 0..1 fraction of the display height
traceDisplaySettings.sourceSync: align Trace Display start to the detected source cycle | Zoom (s) still controls length
traceDisplaySettings.syncChannel: Output stereo trigger source | Off freeruns each channel | Left/Right/Mono share one window so L and R stay time-aligned

wire.selected: click to select this wire | Delete removes selected wire
wire.output: plain drag between this output and a signal input or modulation input to create a wire
wire.parameterOutput: plain drag between this normalized 0..1 slider output and a signal input or modulation input to create a wire
wire.input: plain drag between this signal input and an output to create a wire | to change an existing connection, select and delete the wire, then create a new one
wire.modulationInput: plain drag between this modulation input and an output to create a wire | to change an existing modulation, select and delete the wire, then create a new one

slider.numeric: drag adjusts | Alt+drag sticks to the mouse | Ctrl+click resets to default | Ctrl/Shift drag fine tunes | double-click types | right-click edits metadata
slider.choices: click a segment to choose | Alt+drag sticks to the mouse | Ctrl+click resets to default | double-click types | right-click edits metadata
slider.knob: drag adjusts | Alt+drag sticks to the mouse | Ctrl+click resets to default | Ctrl/Shift drag fine tunes | double-click types

audio.inputDeviceUnavailable: browser audio input device selection unavailable
audio.inputDeviceMissing: browser has not exposed audio input devices yet
audio.liveInputConnected: live INPUT is connected to the browser audio engine
audio.liveInputVisible: live INPUT module is visible | start OUTPUT to request microphone access
audio.playBlockedRenderFirst: play blocked: render a sample first
audio.playBlockedScript: play blocked: fix script before render
audio.liveOutputRunningWithInput: live OUTPUT is running with microphone INPUT connected | press Space to stop
audio.liveOutputRunning: live OUTPUT is running | press Space to stop
audio.liveOutputPermissionPending: live OUTPUT requested | browser microphone permission may be pending | press Space to stop
audio.liveOutputRequested: live OUTPUT requested | graph may be blocked | press Space to stop
audio.liveOutputWithInput: start live OUTPUT and request browser microphone permission | press Space to toggle
audio.liveOutputStart: start live OUTPUT | press Space to toggle

actions.addModule: click to add or show module
actions.copyPatch: copy the whole patch as script text to the clipboard
actions.pastePatch: replace the current patch with script text from the clipboard
actions.sharePatch: copy a shareable link to this patch to the clipboard
actions.copyUnavailableOutput: copy unavailable: Output module is required
actions.copyUnavailableWire: copy unavailable: selected object is a wire
actions.deleteUnavailableOutput: delete unavailable: Output module is required
actions.deleteWireMissing: delete unavailable: selected wire no longer exists

wireType.cable: draw this selected wire with the current curvy cable style
wireType.trace: draw this selected wire as a crisp up/down/left/right circuit trace

actions.wirePixel: Pixel wire (manual). Marks this cable for a future raster beam renderer — off by default, never auto.
actions.copyExecutionJson: click to copy the full compiled execution JSON
actions.copyRuntimeSketch: click to copy the caller-owned C++ runtime sketch
actions.widthDecrease: decrease this module width by one grid unit
actions.widthIncrease: increase this module width by one grid unit
actions.moduleAlias: cosmetic title shown on this module | empty uses the real module name
actions.textBoxHeightDecrease: decrease this text box height by one grid unit
actions.textBoxHeightIncrease: increase this text box height by one grid unit
actions.textBoxTextSizeDecrease: decrease this text box text size
actions.textBoxTextSizeIncrease: increase this text box text size
actions.hideModuleButtons: hide this module's header buttons | actions button stays visible so this can be undone
actions.textBoxSingleLine: use a single-line text box layout
actions.textBoxMultiline: use a multiline text box layout (manual size; shrinks if too wide)
actions.textBoxFill: multiline text that grows or shrinks to fill the available face room
actions.textBoxContent: edit the text displayed by this text module
actions.textBoxVerticalPosition: set text vertical position as a percentage of unused space
